key_reasoning.reason: Spans two repositories: backend storage/API/policy/runtime-guard (4 new/changed backend modules) plus frontend Models tab, member-override modal, six model-picker consumers (chat prompt/config, assistant form, two workflow-editor forms), Overview indicators, and IA/permission fixes. Full-stack across two applications sharing one API contract — XL, not XXL, since it is one product's two repos with an internal contract, not multiple external services.

New access-control surface: the first review round found two real information-disclosure gaps (an unauthenticated project-model probe, member_overrides leaked to non-managers) plus a fallback-resolution bug that could have left a live agent constructed with an unresolved model. Security-sensitive, on a path that affects live agent construction — XL.

63 files changed across both repos (git diff --stat vs main): 55 in codemie-ui, 8 in codemie. Well past the 16+/6+ new files XXL threshold — driven by the number of model-picker consumers touched plus the pre-existing budget/member-management work carried in the same MR by explicit user direction.

Ticket had 11 acceptance criteria but no attachments, comments, or linked spec; criterion 3's 'clients' scope was undefined and remains unresolved (flagged partial in every review pass). Existing patterns (the chargeback JSONB-column precedent, the existing GET /v1/llm_models endpoint) applied directly once found, keeping this at L rather than XL.

UI + API + service/policy + persistence (new column + migration) + the runtime agent-construction layer, plus a cross-cutting concern (authorization) added to two endpoints mid-implementation. XL: full stack plus a cross-cutting concern, per the dimension's own XL example.
